body:
# 🎲 YuRandomTeleport Random Teleport Plugin

## 🛡️ Safe Locations | ⚡ Async Search | 📦 Location Pre‑caching | 🌿 Biome Filtering | 🚶 Auto Scatter | 🧵 Folia Support

😱 Still worried that random teleport will dump players into lava, flooded caves, walls, void edges or dangerous Nether platforms?  
🗺️ Still manually maintaining teleport points for resource worlds, wilderness exploration, or player distribution on survival servers?  
🐌 Still suffering from main‑thread freezes while traditional RTP searches for chunks, countdowns that only spam chat, and making players re‑enter commands after a failure?

🎉 **YuRandomTeleport** is a Minecraft Java server plugin built around **“safe random teleportation”**.  
✨ It doesn't just pick a random coordinate – it folds permissions, cooldowns, economy, waiting, chunk loading, safety scanning, teleport execution and feedback effects into a single, controllable flow.

---

# 🚀 New Core Highlights

- ⚡ **Async Safe‑Spot Search**: Paper 1.13+ can use asynchronous chunk loading to reduce main‑thread pressure; automatically falls back to sync mode when unavailable.
- 📦 **Location Pre‑caching**: The background prepares usable destinations in advance. When a cache hit occurs, teleport happens instantly – ideal for high‑frequency RTP resource worlds.
- 🌿 **Biome Blacklist / Whitelist**: Supports `*` wildcards, can exclude oceans, rivers and other biomes, and also allows a one‑off target biome to be set via command.
- ⭕ **Circle / Square Distribution**: Supports classic square ring zones and area‑uniform circular ring zones, with a customisable centre point.
- 🏃 **Automatic Random Teleport**: Supports automatic scattering on first join and on respawn, with the ability to respect beds and respawn anchors.
- 💰 **Vault + PlayerPoints**: Choose between coin‑based or point‑based economy. Built‑in refund on failure, balance re‑check, and duplicate‑request protection.
- 👥 **Group Cooldowns & Costs**: Give VIP/MVP different cooldowns and costs via the `yurtp.group.<groupname>` permission.
- 💾 **Persistent Cooldowns**: Unfinished cooldowns survive server restarts, preventing players from exploiting restarts to refresh their cooldown.
- ⏳ **Multi‑channel Countdown**: Chat, BossBar, ActionBar and silent waiting can be freely combined; interruption conditions can be toggled individually.
- 🎵 **Full Audio‑Visual Feedback**: Countdown sounds (pitch rises each second), success arpeggios, titles, particles, click‑to‑retry on failure, hover‑to‑see coordinates on success.
- 📊 **PlaceholderAPI Expansion**: 45+ placeholders covering cooldown, cost, group, status, success rate, world config and pre‑cache state.
- 🧩 **Java API + Lifecycle Events**: Commands and the API share the same `TeleportService` – what the command can do, the API can do; events can be listened to and cancelled for deep integrations.
- 🧵 **Folia Scheduler Adapted**: Supports Region / Entity / Global Schedulers, executing search and teleport according to the thread model.

---

# 🖥️ Compatibility Range

## 📦 Minecraft Versions

The plugin targets cross‑version compatibility for the **Minecraft 1.8.x – 1.26.x+** Bukkit / Spigot / Paper ecosystem.

Features automatically detect and degrade by version:

- 📊 BossBar, particles: require newer Bukkit API; silently skipped when unsupported.
- 📝 Titles, ActionBar, hex colours: enabled on supported versions, fallback displays on older ones.
- ⚡ Paper async chunk loading: async search is used when available, otherwise sync.
- ⛏️ 1.18+ world height: automatically reads the world’s min/max height, compatible with negative‑Y worlds.

## 🧱 Server Cores

- 🟢 CraftBukkit / Spigot
- 🟣 Paper / Purpur / Leaves and most Paper‑derived cores
- 🧵 Folia
- ⚙️ Mohist / Arclight / Youer / CatServer and other hybrid cores
- 🔧 Any other server core that follows Bukkit / Spigot / Paper API

Economy and integration features are soft‑dependencies:

- 💰 Vault: required when using coin economy; needs a compatible economy plugin.
- 💎 PlayerPoints: required when choosing points economy.
- 📊 PlaceholderAPI: registers `%yurtp_*%` placeholders when installed; plugin runs independently without it.

---

# 🧠 Safe‑Location Algorithm

YuRandomTeleport checks before teleporting:

- 🧱 Whether the block under the player’s feet can support them
- 🚶 Whether body and head space is sufficient
- 🌬️ Whether the required extra air height above the head is met
- 🔥 Dangerous blocks: water, lava, fire, cactus, cobweb, magma blocks, etc.
- 🌑 Void, world min/max height, world border
- 🌿 Biome blacklist / whitelist
- 🔮 Vertical candidate positions in complex dimensions like the Nether

🛡️ Greatly reduces the chance of:

- 😵 Players stuck in walls or blocks
- 🌋 Teleporting into lava, underwater or dangerous blocks
- 🚧 Landing outside or exactly on the world border
- 🕳️ Ending up at the void edge or mid‑air
- 🔥 Nether locations with no standable platform

🔧 Safety rules can be overridden per world – different strategies for the overworld, Nether, End, resource worlds or event worlds.

---

# 🌍 Per‑World Independent Configuration

Every world can override the defaults:

- 💵 Cost
- ⏱️ Cooldown
- 📏 Random radius
- 🎯 Random centre point
- ⭕ Square / Circle distribution
- 📐 Height range
- 🎲 Maximum search attempts
- 🧱 Block blacklist / whitelist
- 🌿 Biome blacklist / whitelist

Omitted nodes inherit from `default` – no need to repeat the full config for every world.

🗂️ Typical usage:

- 🏠 Overworld: large radius, normal cost, exclude oceans
- 🌳 Resource world: huge radius, high cost, async search and pre‑caching enabled
- 🔥 Nether: restricted height, higher max attempts, safe‑footing block whitelist
- 🎉 Event world: only allowed for certain permission groups, or completely disable RTP

---

# ⚡ Async Search & Location Pre‑caching

🐌 Traditional RTP often loads new chunks synchronously during teleport, easily causing lag spikes.

YuRandomTeleport offers two optimisations:

## ⚡ Asynchronous Safe‑Spot Search

```yaml
teleport:
  search-mode: async
```

On Paper 1.13+ and compatible cores, the plugin uses async chunk loading to find a destination.  
🔁 If the server core doesn’t support async chunk loading, the plugin automatically falls back to sync mode and logs a notice.

The default remains `sync`, ensuring predictable behaviour for servers upgrading from older versions.

## 📦 Location Pre‑caching

```yaml
teleport:
  precache:
    enabled: true
    size: 3
```

The plugin can prepare 1–16 safe locations per world in the background.  
🎯 When a player triggers a teleport and a cache match is found, the online search phase is skipped and the teleport proceeds directly to validation.

💡 Pre‑caching requires Folia or a Paper‑based core that supports async chunk loading.  
🔄 After changing config or running `/yurtp reload`, the old cache is automatically cleared.

---

# 🌿 Biome Filtering & Targeted Biome Teleport

🚫 Don’t want players randomised into oceans, rivers, swamps or other unsuitable biomes?

```yaml
default:
  safety:
    blocked-biomes:
      - "*OCEAN*"
      - "RIVER"
    allowed-biomes: []
```

🌟 Capabilities:

- 🔲 Both blacklist and whitelist modes
- ⭐ `*` wildcards
- 🔠 Case‑insensitive matching
- 🌍 Per‑world overrides
- 🏔️ For 1.16+ 3D biomes, checks are based on the candidate height

🎫 Players or admins with the `yurtp.biome` permission can also specify a one‑off target biome:

```text
/yurtp biome:*FOREST*
/yurtp biome:DESERT
/yurtp Steve world biome:*PLAINS*
```

🎮 Perfect for exploration quests, event maps, themed resource worlds and menu‑plugin integrations.

---

# ⏳ Countdown, Interruption & Feedback

⏲️ The pre‑teleport wait is no longer confined to chat spam.

```yaml
teleport:
  wait-seconds: 5
  countdown-display: "bossbar, actionbar"
  cancel-on-move: true
  cancel-triggers:
    move: true
    damage: true
    interact: true
    chat: true
    command: true
```

📺 Supported display channels:

- 💬 Chat
- 📊 BossBar
- 📝 ActionBar
- 🤫 Silent (no visible countdown)

🚷 Supported interruption triggers:

- 🏃 Movement
- 🤕 Taking damage
- ✋ Interacting
- 💬 Chatting
- ⌨️ Executing commands

🛡️ Effectively reduces issues like PvP escaping, avoiding risk during combat, and malicious repeated RTP triggering.

⚡ Players with `yurtp.bypass.wait` permission skip the waiting period.

---

# 🎵 Audio‑Visual Effects

🎶 Built‑in effects are ready to use and can also be disabled entirely:

- 🔊 Countdown alert sounds, pitch rising as time decreases
- 🎹 Distinct sounds for search start, fee deduction, refund, failure, cancellation
- 🎵 Three‑note success arpeggio
- 📺 Searching / Success / Failure titles, following the player’s language
- ✨ Departure and arrival particles
- 🔁 Click‑to‑retry on failure messages
- 🧾 Hover to see exact coordinates on success messages
- 🎨 1.16+ supports `&#RRGGBB` hex colours; older versions degrade gracefully

The default configuration provides a ready‑made experience, and server owners can customise sounds, titles and particles to match their server’s style.

---

# 💰 Economy System

```yaml
economy:
  enabled: true
  provider: vault # vault or playerpoints
```

💵 Supports:

- 💰 Vault coin economy
- 💎 PlayerPoints point economy
- 🌍 Per‑world cost
- 👥 Per‑group cost override
- 🛡️ Admin or VIP fee exemption
- 🚫 Insufficient balance notification
- 🔄 Balance re‑check after waiting (in case of changes)
- 💸 Automatic refund on teleport failure
- 🔒 Duplicate teleport protection to avoid double charging

💎 PlayerPoints points are integers; costs are rounded up, and refunds follow the same rule.

---

# 👥 Group Cooldowns & Costs

```yaml
groups:
  vip:
    cooldown-seconds: 10
    cost: 5.0
  mvp:
    cooldown-seconds: 0
    cost: 0.0
```

🎯 Players with `yurtp.group.vip` or `yurtp.group.mvp` automatically inherit the corresponding config.  
🔢 When multiple groups match, the first one in config order is applied.

✨ Enables:

- 👤 Regular players: 30‑second cooldown
- 💎 VIP: 10‑second cooldown
- 👑 MVP: no cooldown, free teleport
- 🎉 Temporarily reduce a group’s cost during events

💾 Cooldowns can be persisted in `cooldowns.yml` so they survive server restarts.

---

# 🚶 Automatic Random Teleport

```yaml
auto-rtp:
  first-join:
    enabled: true
    world: ""
    delay-ticks: 40
  respawn:
    enabled: false
    world: ""
    respect-bed: true
```

🚀 Two types of automatic scattering:

- 🆕 First‑join: new players are automatically scattered on initial login
- 💀 Respawn: players are scattered when they respawn after death

⚡ Automatic triggers skip the countdown but still obey permissions, world access, cooldown, economy and safety rules.  
🛏️ Respawning can respect beds and respawn anchors to avoid breaking normal respawn gameplay.

🌍 Ideal for:

- 🌳 New‑player survival servers
- ⛏️ Resource worlds
- 💀 Hardcore survival
- 🔫 Battle‑royale / event worlds
- 🚫 Servers where spawn resources need to be protected

---

# 📊 PlaceholderAPI, Java API & Event System

📊 When PlaceholderAPI is installed, 45+ `%yurtp_*%` placeholders become available.

🔖 Frequently used examples:

```text
%yurtp_cooldown_formatted%
%yurtp_cooldown_bar%
%yurtp_ready_display%
%yurtp_cost%
%yurtp_can_afford_display%
%yurtp_group%
%yurtp_status_display%
%yurtp_success_rate%
%yurtp_search_mode%
%yurtp_precache_cached%
%yurtp_world_allowed_world%
%yurtp_cost_resource%
```

🎯 Perfect for:

- 📊 Scoreboards
- 📋 TAB lists
- 🧩 Menu plugins
- 📜 Quest plugins
- 🏆 Achievement systems
- 📈 Statistics panels

🧑‍💻 Developers can obtain the public Java API via Bukkit `ServicesManager` and listen to the full lifecycle events:

- 🟢 `RandomTeleportStartEvent`
- 🟡 `RandomTeleportDestinationEvent`
- 🔴 `RandomTeleportCancelEvent`
- 🟣 `RandomTeleportCompleteEvent`

🔄 Commands and the API share the same `TeleportService`, so policies are consistent – there is no way to bypass checks through the API.

---

# 🕹️ Command Quick Reference

## 👤 Player Commands

```text
/rtp
/yurtp
```

🎲 Randomly teleport yourself.

```text
/yurtp biome:<pattern>
```

🌿 Randomly teleport yourself to a matching biome. Requires `yurtp.biome` permission.

## 🛠️ Admin Commands

```text
/yurtp <player>
/yurtp <player> <world>
/yurtp <player> <world> biome:<pattern>
/yurtp reload
/yurtp help
```

---

# 🔑 Permission Quick Reference

| 🔒 Permission | 📝 Description | 👥 Default |
|---|---|---|
| `yurtp.use` | Use random teleport | Everyone |
| `yurtp.biome` | Use `biome:<pattern>` parameter | OP |
| `yurtp.teleport.others` | Teleport other players | OP |
| `yurtp.reload` | Reload configuration | OP |
| `yurtp.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass own cooldown | OP |
| `yurtp.bypass.cooldown.others` | Bypass target’s cooldown when teleporting others | OP |
| `yurtp.bypass.cost` | Exempt from cost | OP |
| `yurtp.bypass.wait` | Skip the wait countdown | OP |
| `yurtp.group.<groupname>` | Apply group cooldown & cost | Assigned by permission plugin |
